items.text: 👋 Hi everyone,
We have an important update to share: Kalanoro will now launch on September 24.
The reason behind this new date? We're thrilled to announce that SEGA is partnering with us to publish and launch Kalanoro in Japan and and selected Asian markets.
Aligning our release with this opportunity gives the game the visibility, support, and reach we could only have dreamed of.
This also means Kalanoro will be part of Tokyo Game Show, one of the biggest gaming events in the world, helping us introduce the game to many more players from day one.
Ultimately, this change isn't about adding more time for the sake of it, it's about giving Kalanoro the best possible chance to succeed and helping the game reach a much wider audience.

We know waiting a few extra weeks can be disappointing, and we're incredibly grateful for your patience and support. Every wishlist, comment and kind word you've shared has helped us get here, and we're more excited than ever for what's ahead.
We'll have plenty more to show you between now and launch, so stay tuned, we can't wait to share what's coming next! Thank you for sticking with us 🐒💖
In the meantime, if you haven’t already, give Kalanoro a try!

releases.displayName: Kalanoro Demo Update — Jyeuhair Joins the Adventure 👀🎤

items.text: Hey everyone,
Today’s Kalanoro demo update introduces a very special guest: Malagasy artist Jyeuhair joins the world of Kalanoro with a brand-new in-game appearance and original song.
And yes — this exclusive collaboration is ONLY available in the demo! ✨
Watch our brand-new trailer which might — or might not — contain a major announcement about Kalanoro’s release date 👀
🎤 New Content
Added Jyeuhair as a special guest to the demo, joining Kalakely during a new Live Music Performance featuring an original song composed exclusively for Kalanoro!
Fixed an issue where audio would stop after pressing Alt+Tab
Fixed the mouse issue causing automatic character movement after closing a tutorial popup
Fixed the Great Sage and Mille-Clement names being truncated during cutscenes
Fixed the issue causing the game language to unexpectedly change during gameplay

The mouse cursor may become invisible when left-clicking or right-clicking on empty areas of the inventory. The cursor remains active and all interactions continue to work as expected. This issue is visual only and does not impact gameplay progression.
The wait is almost over: Kalanoro will launch on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch on August 27, 2026.
Wishlist the game now and get ready to explore Lemuria, build your band, and uncover the mysteries hidden across the island.
See you on the road this August! 🎸✨

Hey from Lemuria,
We’re aware of a few minor issues we’re currently working on. In the meantime, here’s a quick guide to help you enjoy the demo to the fullest:
For the best experience, we highly recommend playing with a controller.
In the Main Menu, if a player selects New Game and then presses Back (B), the menu focus may be lost. To resolve this, simply move the joystick to restore the focus.
On the Bus, players may occasionally encounter unexpected or slightly chaotic behavior (e.g. a lemur not sleeping or not dancing).
If this occurs, it can be resolved by going to the System menu and selecting Restart Level.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46095305/3ad2476af4d7ef11a7b0c824afbbe25712bc2ddd.png"]
In Multi-Level Beach, if the player goes through the portal while carrying a baby lemur on their back, the baby lemur may be permanently lost.
If this occurs, it can be resolved by going to the System menu and selecting Restart Level.
